description: Chereeka Garner recounts her experience as a high school senior on September 11, 2001, in an interview recorded at UCF’s John C. Hitt Library for the Night Tales Project. She was attending University High School in Orlando and arrived early to join her senior class for a panoramic yearbook photograph. After helping clean up, she waited in the courtyard and later crossed to another campus, where she found students watching television and learned that a plane had hit the World Trade Center. Garner recalls watching repeated news coverage, feeling confused by the quiet and by the sparse presence of people around her, and calling her father to ask what was happening. She describes seeing a long line of parents signing students out of school and eventually remaining at school until the end of the day. She says she understood the magnitude of the attacks more fully after she went home and found that her father had left work early.

entities_and_facets.perspective: First-person recollection of the attacks’ news and effects at school; Garner describes television coverage and does not claim to have been at an attack site.
